entries.question: Hello sir /ma'am,, i wanted to ask the confirm date of nursing officer recruitment post exam . Because there is so many confusion about the exam date,, some are saying that exam is on 14 November and some are saying that exam is not on 14 November.. i kindly request you to please tell us the confirm and exact date of the nursing officer exam date ... I will be Highly obliged,,, Please reply,,, thank you so much
entries.answer: You're welcome! If you have any more questions about KGMU, don't hesitate to ask. | "आपका स्वागत है! यदि आपके पास KGMU के बारे में और प्रश्न हैं, तो पूछने में संकोच न करें।"
